question: Who shall have the duty to give advice to the Government of India upon legal matters from time to time as per Article 76 of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Attorney General__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Attorney General (Article 76):**

 
 
• The Attorney General is the **chief legal advisor** to the **government of India.**
 
• Appointed by the **President of India**, he holds office at the pleasure of the President.
 
• The Attorney General **represents the government** in **legal matters** and** gives advice to the government **on legal issues.
 
• They have the** right of audience in all courts in India**, as well as the right to participate in the** proceedings of the Parliament**.
